facts.label: What each contract does
facts.example: e.g. a vault: deposit ETH, withdraw after a lock

facts.label: Who can call what
facts.assumed: Assumed: an owner who can change settings, and anyone for everything else.
facts.example: e.g. only the owner sets the fee; anyone deposits

facts.label: Numbers the contracts enforce
facts.assumed: The builders will choose them and write them in the README.
facts.example: e.g. 0.3% fee, 7-day lock, max 10 ETH per wallet

facts.label: Upgrades and pausing
facts.assumed: Assumed: not upgradeable and not pausable.
facts.example: e.g. not upgradeable; owner can pause
